result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 4, Health and Sanitation) covering fertilizer storage, manure handling, septic and cesspool regulations, sanitary toilets, and adoption of the County animal control ordinance.
result.notes: This part of the document (sections 44.0203 to 44.0300) contains only health, sanitation and animal control provisions. None addresses rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The page URL suggests the full page concerns San Diego's algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition (§ 98.1103), but no such text appears in this part, so no rules are extracted.
